battlebond.desc: Eligible Arcanine, Garchomp and Greninja transform after a move KO while another foe remains. Bond forms heal 1/8 base max HP after move KOs. Heals 1/16 base max HP each turn and prevents sandstorm/hail damage. Attack power is 1.3x against Royal Decree, Empress or Neutralization and independently 1.3x on Cold Eclipse. Cannot be suppressed or swapped. No Filter damage reduction or lethal-hit survival.
battlebond.shortDesc: A KO can trigger a Bond form; no lethal-hit survival.

apexvenom.desc: Strong Jaw gives biting attacks 1.5x power. Poison Fang has no separate signature multiplier. Retains local Poison/Steel matchup overrides, bite protection bypass and toxic chance, and Shed Skin.
apexvenom.shortDesc: Strong Jaw 1.5x; retains poison matchups and Shed Skin.

sirius.desc: Retains full Apex Venom, Whiplash, Venam’s Kiss and local Shed Skin (50% end-turn ailment/low-HP recovery; Dragon’s Den guaranteed). Mega Seviper’s Poison Fang slot becomes Drake Fang: 85 BP Dragon Physical, 100 accuracy, 15 PP, bite/contact and inherited poison effects. Current PP and slot persist through switching; actual form reversal restores Poison Fang. Strong Jaw gives Fang attacks 1.5x power before STAB, with no separate signature multiplier. Dragon Drake Fang uses ordinary Dragon effectiveness and does not trigger Poison-only Venam effects. Poison HP hits poison eligible Steel/Poison foes; all foes can be drained (one-third damage, capped at 1/4 base max HP per turn), while already-poisoned foes are heal-blocked and have 0.75x Speed. Cannot be suppressed, replaced or bypassed by Mold Breaker.
sirius.shortDesc: Apex Venom + Whiplash + Venam’s Kiss; Poison Fang becomes Drake Fang.

venomarmor.desc: Dual Wield and Battle Armor. Metal Claw retains two full-power hits. Does not automatically poison, heal or grant the former status-based damage boost.

toxicarmor.desc: Full local Dual Wield, Metal Claw with two full-power hits, and opening Violent Rush. A native positive-priority damaging attack that damages opposing HP prepares the next eligible Dual Wield attack on the following turn for +1 priority. Consumes on attempt, including miss, protection or immunity; expires at that turn end and clears on switching. No stacking, generated attacks, Z/Max attacks or self-rearming from the granted priority. Cannot be suppressed, replaced or bypassed by Mold Breaker.
toxicarmor.shortDesc: Dual Wield + opening Violent Rush; priority hits prepare next-turn priority.
